title: Hezekiah's Illness and Healing
description: King Hezekiah became mortally ill, but prayed to the Lord with weeping. Through the prophet Isaiah, God promised him fifteen additional years of life and healed him with a fig cake. God gave him a sign by making the shadow go ten steps backward on the steps of Ahaz.
